original_question: For visible achromatic metalenses, how do phase/group-delay dispersion limits constrain the joint bandwidth and field of view, and what evidence supports the associated efficiency tradeoffs? Produce a focused evidence-based review plan separating physical bounds, design mechanisms and demonstrated performance. This pilot uses at most three full-text papers and is not a comprehensive review.

facets.ask: What are the fundamental physical bounds imposed by phase and group-delay dispersion on the joint bandwidth and field of view of visible achromatic metalenses?
